family_rule: A family is one (input source, sink, construction, flow, safe strategy) pattern. Variants that only rename identifiers or change constants are the same family and must share a split. Source dimensions: input_source/sink/construct/flow/safe_strategy. HTTP dimensions: location/technique/encoding/normal_counterpart.
assignment: Split chosen by the author, not randomized: dev covers common idioms; the holdout catalog adds patterns absent from dev to measure generalization. Reported as a design choice and a limitation.

families.distinctness_note: Baseline reflected XSS through an f-string view return.
families.basis: Untrusted query value is interpolated into HTML returned with text/html; escape() in the safe twin encodes it.

families.distinctness_note: POST form input, string concatenation via a local variable; sanitizer applied at the source, not at the sink.
families.basis: Form body concatenated into markup; html.escape on input removes markup injection.

families.distinctness_note: Input becomes part of the Jinja template source instead of a context variable.
families.basis: Template source built from input bypasses autoescape (and enables SSTI); passing it as context keeps autoescape.

families.distinctness_note: Markup() marks attacker data as safe; the twin uses Markup.format which escapes arguments.
families.basis: Markup(str % value) disables escaping for the injected value.

families.distinctness_note: Response object sink with explicit text/html content type instead of a bare return.
families.basis: Unescaped query value in an HTML response body.

families.distinctness_note: Attribute (href) context where javascript: URLs matter; safe twin needs scheme validation plus escaping.
families.basis: Attacker controls href attribute value and quotes; javascript: scheme or quote breakout executes script.

families.distinctness_note: Inter-procedural: markup is built in a helper over a generator; hard case for local rules (expected rule false positive on the safe twin).
families.basis: List of query values rendered into table cells without encoding.

families.distinctness_note: Stored XSS: the source is a database row, not the current request.
families.basis: Stored note fields are user-controlled elsewhere and rendered without escaping.

families.distinctness_note: Baseline sqlite3 f-string query.
families.basis: Quoted f-string interpolation lets a quote break out of the literal.

families.distinctness_note: Login form with two injected values through a cursor and a query variable.
families.basis: Authentication bypass by tautology in either concatenated field.

families.distinctness_note: Hard negative: both twins contain '%s'; only the driver-parameter form is safe.
families.basis: Python % formatting interpolates before the driver; passing a params tuple binds safely.

families.distinctness_note: ORDER BY identifier cannot be bound; safe twin still formats but only from an allowlist.
families.basis: Identifier injection in ORDER BY; mapping through a constant dict removes attacker control.

families.distinctness_note: Sink lives in a helper whose argument is request data passed by the view.
families.basis: Helper concatenates its parameter into SQL; caller passes the query argument.

families.distinctness_note: executescript runs stacked statements and cannot take parameters.
families.basis: Stacked-query injection through executescript; safe twin splits into bound execute calls.

families.distinctness_note: ORM-level raw SQL via sqlalchemy.text rather than a DB-API cursor.
families.basis: text() with interpolation is raw SQL; named bind parameters are safe.

families.distinctness_note: Hard negative: safe twin concatenates, but only into the bound parameter value.
families.basis: LIKE pattern built in SQL text vs. wildcard added to the bound value.

families.distinctness_note: Baseline shell command via os.system.
families.basis: Shell metacharacters in host run extra commands.

families.distinctness_note: Safe twin keeps the shell sink but quotes the argument.
families.basis: os.popen invokes a shell; shlex.quote prevents metacharacter interpretation.

families.distinctness_note: subprocess with shell=True and a formatted command variable.
families.basis: shell=True with attacker-controlled folder name.

families.distinctness_note: Module imported under an alias (import subprocess as sp).
families.basis: Aliased subprocess.call with shell=True and concatenated file name.

families.distinctness_note: Bare name from `from os import system`; safe twin keeps the shell sink with an allowlisted constant command.
families.basis: Action parameter concatenated into systemctl command.

families.distinctness_note: Command string assembled in a helper and executed by the caller.
families.basis: Quote breakout in grep pattern and file name reach the shell.

families.distinctness_note: An argv list is joined back into a shell string; the safe twin passes the list directly.
families.basis: JSON fields joined with spaces and run with shell=True.

families.distinctness_note: Hard negative: safe twin still uses a shell sink but only with a parsed IP address.
families.basis: getoutput always uses a shell; ipaddress parsing constrains the argument.

families.distinctness_note: Classic reflected script tag; normal twin contains '<3' text.
families.basis: Script tag payload in search parameter.

families.distinctness_note: Event-handler payload in JSON; normal mentions 'img' without markup.
families.basis: img onerror payload in profile field.

families.distinctness_note: Double URL encoding inside a form body.
families.basis: svg onload payload after two decoding passes.

families.distinctness_note: URI scheme payload in a redirect parameter.
families.basis: javascript: URL in next parameter.

families.distinctness_note: UNION-based extraction; normal twin uses the word 'union' in a search.
families.basis: UNION SELECT against users table.

families.distinctness_note: Payload inside a credential field that is masked in every public view.
families.basis: ' or '1'='1 login bypass.

families.distinctness_note: Blind time-based payload in JSON.
families.basis: SLEEP(5) appended to an identifier.

families.distinctness_note: Payload in a Cookie header that is masked in previews.
families.basis: AND tautology in a tracking cookie.

families.distinctness_note: Command chaining with ';'.
families.basis: ; cat /etc/passwd after a host.

families.distinctness_note: $() substitution; normal twin has a dollar amount.
families.basis: $(whoami) in an export name.

families.distinctness_note: Hard negative: normal twin uses Markdown backticks (expected rule false positive).
families.basis: Backtick substitution downloading and piping a script.

families.distinctness_note: Payload in a request header rather than parameters.
families.basis: && id appended to a monitoring user agent.
